name: Pare-Bench
intro: Pare-Bench 是 PARE 主动助手研究环境中的评测基准，包含 143 个跨通信、生产力、日程和生活应用的多样任务。PARE 将移动应用建模为有限状态机，并通过主动用户仿真构造情境，使 proactive assistant 必须观察用户行为、推断目标、判断干预时机并跨应用执行任务。
org: University of California, Santa Barbara; Apple; University of Washington; Independent Researcher
build_method: 有限状态机应用建模, 四阶段Agent场景生成, Oracle重试, 人工语义核验
metric: Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate
task_type: 主动助手任务, Agent任务, 多应用编排
eval_feature: 主动性, 状态依赖用户仿真, 扁平助手API, Oracle校验, 工具失败与噪声通知
task_type_en: Proactive assistant task, Agent task, Multi-app orchestration
build_method_en: Finite-state app modeling, four-stage agent scenario generation, oracle retries, human semantic review
eval_feature_en: Proactivity, state-dependent user simulation, flat assistant APIs, oracle validation, tool failures and noise notifications
intro_en: Pare-Bench is the benchmark built on the PARE proactive assistant research environment. It contains 143 diverse tasks across communication, productivity, scheduling, and lifestyle apps. PARE models mobile applications as finite state machines and uses active user simulation, forcing proactive assistants to observe user behavior, infer goals, decide when to intervene, and execute tasks across apps.
metric_en: Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2604.00842 and the official PARE repository. The environment contains nine FSM applications plus the System, Agent UI, and FileSystem core apps; users receive state-dependent actions while assistants use flat APIs. A Claude Agent SDK generation agent performs four stages: unique story description, app initialization/population, event-flow construction with user/agent oracle actions, and validation criteria. Stages two through four run in oracle mode with failure feedback and retries, followed by human checks for semantic coherence, event realism, and validation correctness. The final 143 scenarios support optional tool failures and Poisson noise notifications and report Success@4, Success^4, Success Rate, Proposal Rate, Acceptance Rate, and read-only actions.
